folder_html:
LIVE WAVE DIRECTION

Mean wave direction on the lakes right now, in compass degrees exactly as filed by the NOAA wave model. Color tells direction at a glance; arrows show which way the waves are traveling.

Wave direction (compass degrees, as filed by GLWU WVDIR): LOWEST 0 N dark-blue → 45 NE cyan → 90 E green → 135 SE yellow → 180 S orange → 225 SW red → 270 W magenta → 315 NW violet → HIGHEST+ 360 N dark-purple (wrap: both ends northerly). Same degree always shows the same color. Arrows point where the waves are traveling (filed direction + 180°). Lake mean now: 134° (SE).

Units: degrees (compass: 0/360=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W)
